items.title: MECH-428/INV-086 waypoint_field_consumer_reach H1 (drive axis): does the TRAINING SIGNAL (sparse vs shaped vs demo-warmstart) determine whether field-perceivability converts into navigation?
items.note:
H1 (drive/training-signal axis) of the GOV-FANOUT-1 two-leg waypoint_field_consumer_reach portfolio pre-registered by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1004_2026-09-05 (fanout_recommendation.suggested_probes[0]; registry qid waypoint_field_consumer_reach, hid H-wpfield-objective-sparsity). H2 (representation axis, V3-EXQ-1030) is the sibling leg, already queued and returned (FAIL/CONTESTED, unrelated to this leg's own verdict since GOV-FANOUT-1 legs are independent). QUESTION: holding the SD-WAYPOINT-FIELD observable ON and the consumer construction fixed (a REEAgent built via the V3-EXQ-724/734/737/742 "all-ON" config -- E1/E2/E3, dACC, OFC, lateral-PFC and modulatory-authority all live; action selection every tick is the REAL agent.generate_trajectories -> agent.select_action loop, imported unmodified from experiments/_lib/allon_training.py's _train_all_on_agent -- NOT the MECH-457 fanout's actor_critic_step bolt-on, and NOT V3-EXQ-1004's bespoke BC-clone reader), does the TRAINING SIGNAL determine whether field-perceivability converts into navigation? Three arms x 3 seeds (42/43/44): sparse_rl (stock waypoint reward only), shaped_rl (same + a monotone non-negative per-step progress bonus toward the pending waypoint), demo_warmstart (an auxiliary oracle-supervised CE warm-start of the lateral-PFC bias head, then the identical RL procedure as sparse_rl). Plus greedy_oracle/random_walk anchors. DV: waypoints_visited_per_ep. DECLARED NULL: visits/ep flat across all three arms -> sparsity is not the residual blocker (H1 not supported). A cleared lift under shaped_rl or demo_warmstart while sparse_rl stays blocked supports H1.

CAVEAT (per chip instruction): V3-EXQ-1004's docstring-only, never-committed, pre-SD-094-gate A2C figure (0.00/0.10 visits/ep, seed 42, self-contaminating env) motivates this leg's existence and is not cited as a baseline, bar, or comparison point anywhere in this script.

CLAIMS: INV-086/MECH-428 tagged read-across only, evidence_direction_per_claim = non_contributory unconditionally -- this design exercises neither claim's own what_would_answer regime (no z_goal ablation for INV-086's WM-decay/feedback-channel regime; no forced-seed control for MECH-428's seeding-sparse z_goal_norm regime), and additionally (module docstring "WHAT THIS IS NOT") the reward-driven learning trains the lateral-PFC bias head and OFC devaluation head, not E3's own scoring-head parameters -- stated explicitly so the claim-tagging call is checkable against source.

GOV-REUSE-1 (2.4): reanalysis_query.py --readout visits_per_episode --claim MECH-428 checked against v3_exq_884 (substrate_hash 0091fba4d567a1ae), v3_exq_1030 (85adf63e99c09c71) and v3_exq_1004 (9a9fbe795140370f) -- 0/3 carry the readout -> not recoverable, run.

Substrate readiness (2.5/2.5a): waypoint-proximity-field-observable gate released 2026-09-05 (implemented_validated, corrupting->degrading), confirmed live in substrate_queue.json before queuing; does not block. Re-derive brake (2.5b, re-checked fresh at write time 2026-09-14T23:26Z): INV-086 = 0 counted autopsies, MECH-428 = 1 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-884_2026-08-03) -- both below threshold 2, brake does not fire. Substrate-path overlap (2.5c, re-checked fresh): every open substrate_queue.json entry overlapping this driver's exercised modules (ree_core/agent.py, causal_grid_world.py, utils/config.py, latent/stack.py, latent/zworld_p0.py) is severity degrading/cosmetic/unset, none corrupting -- does not block (SD-018/SD-106 concern optional zworld_p0 amend legs this driver never enables; mech357/SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING concern hazard/freeze mechanisms this driver zeroes via navigation isolation).

STEP 4.5 RED-TEAM (fable-5.1, cross-model, one pass): BLOCKING (1) + CONTESTED (5) + CLEAR (6), full findings in the module's git history / session record. F1 BLOCKING (fixed): the original design shaped the reward with a Ng-Harada-Russell potential-DIFFERENCE term (gamma=1.0). Verified at source that _train_all_on_agent's P1 REINFORCE credits every tick in an episode with the SAME whole-episode return (ep_reward, summed once and broadcast to every outcome tuple) -- under that objective a telescoping potential-difference collapses to the single boundary term Phi(s_T)-Phi(s_0), which is dominated by env respawn/commitment-timeout noise rather than by anything resembling reward density, making any shaped_rl outcome unattributable to the registered hypothesis under any result. FIXED: replaced with a monotone, non-negative, additive (non-cancelling) per-step progress bonus toward the pending waypoint -- genuinely densifies the whole-episode credit and is clamped >=0 so it cannot introduce a new negative harm_signal tick beyond what the (provably non-negative in this nav-isolated config) unshaped env already produces. F2 CONTESTED (disclosed, not eliminated): the shaped reward's harm_signal also drives agent.update_residue's benefit-accumulation path, so shaped_rl activates REE's residue/benefit machinery more than the other arms on progress steps -- an intrinsic, disclosed consequence of using more reward signal via the same channel that drives both the RL credit and the substrate's affective bookkeeping; decoupling them would require editing the shared _train_all_on_agent, out of scope. The negative-harm-signal / E3-commitment-abort asymmetry F2 also raised is closed by F1's fix (non-negative bonus). F3 CONTESTED (fixed): nothing certified the ONE component every arm's training signal actually trains (the lateral-PFC bias head, zero-initialised last layer) ever receives a non-zero gradient -- the dry-run's own demo_ce_final_loss == ln(K) signature at authoring scale was consistent with an exactly-zero gradient. Added readiness precondition C0d (lpfc_bias_head_trainable_majority_cells): the bias head's last-linear weight norm must move from its pre-training snapshot AND LateralPFCAnalog's own candidate_summary_degenerate flag must read non-degenerate, on a majority of treatment cells, else substrate_not_ready_requeue. F4 CONTESTED (fixed): demo_warmstart's CE target silently defaulted to candidate 0 when no candidate matched the oracle direction, training "prefer whatever the proposer ranks first" on a miss rather than skipping it -- now skips the update on a miss and records demo_n_target_matched/demo_n_target_defaulted separately. F5-F8, F10-F11 CLEAR (per-seed pairing, RNG fairness/arm isolation, shaping-wrapper non-leakage, CE/REINFORCE sign convention, readiness-gate independence, train/eval observation parity -- all verified against source, no fix needed). F9 CONTESTED (documented): the composite verdict label can read "inconsistent_across_arms" even when one arm (shaped_rl or demo_warmstart) gave a clean directional result -- added a note field to that branch pointing a reader at the per-arm shaped_clears_n_seeds/demo_clears_n_seeds and shaped_lift_per_seed/demo_lift_per_seed fields as the interpretable quantity. F12 CONTESTED (fixed): MIN_DISTINCT_CELLS=4.0 over 80 steps was weak (dry run's own random-walk anchor reached 6 cells in 10 steps) -- raised to 8.0.

BUDGET: deliberately ~13x smaller per cell (20 zworld_p0 + 25 p0_warmup + 90 RL episodes, steps_per_episode=80) than the MECH-457 GOV-FANOUT-1 precedent (V3-EXQ-747/748/749: p0=200+rl=1000 episodes x 200 steps) -- a bounded first probe of a fresh design per queue-experiment Step 3's "measure the DV range at probe scale before pre-registering", not a power-bump. LIFT_MARGIN is expressed as a FRACTION (0.20) of this run's own internally-measured (oracle-random) achievable span rather than an absolute visits/ep literal: an attempted --probe-scale reachability run did not complete within session time under heavy shared-box CPU contention (a concurrent session's REE job held 100-193% CPU and the box's load average reached 5.89 with near-exhausted memory during this session), so no empirical effect size was available to tune an absolute bar against -- the span-relative design is self-calibrating to whatever range this run's own anchors realise instead. Smoke: validate_experiments.py --strict passes clean (0 non-conforming; only the advisory, non-blocking anchor-reachability warning remains, left unexempted per that tool's own guidance for a first-of-lineage statistic, matching V3-EXQ-1030's precedent). --dry-run completed successfully end-to-end BOTH before AND after the Step 4.5 fixes (all 5 arms x 1 seed each time; manifest correctly relocated under dry_run=True; z_goal_stream correctly wired, active_frac=0.000 with writer_calls=150>0 -- the expected reading, not a defect; label=substrate_not_ready_requeue at dry-run's own tiny budget, the correct self-route). The post-fix full dry-run took ~13 minutes wall-clock under heavy multi-session CPU/memory contention on this box (load average up to 5.89, <400MB free of 3.8GB, a concurrent session's job holding 100-193% CPU throughout) rather than the ~1-3 min it took pre-fix on an uncontended box -- contention, not a regression; also independently verified the F1/F3/F4 fixes in isolation via targeted unit checks (_ShapedWaypointEnv's non-negative-reward invariant under an oracle-directed rollout; _score()'s not-ready / baseline-not-blocked / supported branches against synthetic per-seed data) before the full dry-run confirmed the end-to-end pipeline.

items.title: SD-077 centered super-ordinal cue key: raw-key vs centered-key anchor differentiation
items.note: EXP-1186 / EVB-1662. First live test of SD-077: two arms differing ONLY in super_ordinal_cue_centering (False vs True), matched seeds [42,43,44], on the 669b/669c Stage-0 forced-feed nursery. FALSIFIER: R1+R2 met (a common-mode offset is present and writes fire) but the centered arm fails to beat the raw arm by >=4 anchors on >=2/3 seeds, or the centered residual fails to spread the cue geometry by >=0.50 in frac(pairwise cos<0.8) -> SD-077 weakens. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is anchor_count under raw vs centered key on ONE substrate. NOT recoverable -- zero manifests in the corpus tag SD-077; 669b holds an OFF reading (anchor_count=1) on a pre-SD-077 substrate at n_slots=16 and 669c an ON reading on substrate_hash 0e3072c5 at n_slots=64, so a cross-run delta confounds the manipulation with both a substrate change and a bank-size change. 669c held centering ON in all three arms as an enabler and carries no OFF cell. Step 2.5a probe CONFIRMED the knob wires through (som.centering follows the flag, baseline seeds lazily, writes fire). Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 counted autopsies on SD-077. Step 2.5c: three of four open corrupting substrate_queue entries (MECH-320 tonic_vigor, blocked_agency, SD-105 entropy floor) are NOT instantiated under this config (probed: all None); the fourth, contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, IS on the E1 path, but the ADDRESSING half its substrate_paths names is validated-fixed by V3-EXQ-436g and the half still open is the z_world-entropy CONTENT half -- which this run MEASURES as its R1 premise rather than suffers as a confound, and which is identical in both arms so it cannot produce a cross-arm delta. n_slots=1024 because 669c saturated at 64 (anchor_count==n_slots); R3 records cap headroom and is scored against the NULL branch only, so censoring can never vacate a pass. RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, model fable, one pass): CONTESTED -> all findings dispositioned in the module docstring. Headline, fixed: the original load-bearing complexity criterion was a mean over ALL fired writes and DILUTES with run length (the post-salience no-write branch is unreachable at merge 0.8 / cthr 0.2, so allocations thin out as the bank fills); it crossed the margin in both directions between tick 40 and 140 while the anchor delta held at 5-14, i.e. a C1-pass/C3-fail run would have recorded 'weakens' for a denominator artifact. C3 was re-denominated to the length-invariant P0 geometry statistic SD-077 actually asserts; the old form is kept as reported-only C3R with per-write-kind splits so the dilution stays visible. Also fixed: the EMA baseline advances at up to 1-(1-a)^2 because observe() has two call sites (goal.py:514 write, :578 retrieve), so the P0 probe now measures both bounds and C3 routes on the worst; a raw arm that differentiates live with C1 false now routes unknown, not weakens; the centered arm's SECOND anchor is an arithmetic identity (post-lazy-seed residuals are exactly anti-parallel) and C1's margin of 4 is set above that free unit deliberately. Smoke PASS: raw=1 anchor vs centered=8, common_mode_ratio 0.9973 (SD-077's offline recompute measured 0.9949), min_frac_below_delta 0.743 vs a 0.50 bar. validate_recording --strict: complete.

items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a margin-normalised cap rule -- corrected re-test on fresh seeds (R_STAR=2.45, extended sweep, H-KNIFE routing wired)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from governance confidence/conflict scoring). Corrected same-question re-queue of V3-EXQ-935 (FAIL, 2026-08-17), confirmed-autopsied as a pure measurement/instrument defect (REE_assembly evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-935_2026-08-18.md/.json, Step 8 gate cleared 2026-08-18), NOT a substrate ceiling. All four driver defects fixed per the autopsy's Section 9 routing: (1) aliasing control (H-KNIFE) now WIRED into the routing using the CORRECTED experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py primitive (classify_regime_shape, ree-v3 606aea2, >=2-adjacent-swept-values on >=2/3-of-seeds bar), called ONCE over all (seed,r) cells, never per-seed (935's own per-seed info-only call was the exact shape that produced 934's false positive); (2) route_reason derived from the actual criterion states at verdict time, never hardcoded per branch (935's was factually false on its own run); (3) R_STAR=2.45 pre-registered from 935's OWN five-seed sweep (935's imported R_STAR=2.25 did not survive the 3-commit substrate move from 934); (4) ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT gated on a literal substrate_hash comparison against 935's recorded hash (921d0af6b6b6c54b12baafb090984edd9fcc2c3f5bf4ed2ba84d36f6c040b99b), stamped into the manifest as substrate_hash_matches_v3_935, rather than 935's prose assertion of substrate identity (which was in fact false -- 935 ran 3 ree_core commits apart from 934). R_SWEEP extended to [2.25,2.45,2.65,2.85,3.05] so the graded window's UPPER edge is measured (935 topped out at 2.65, still grading 4/5 seeds; a seed-42-class agent needs r>2.65, untested by 935). SEEDS=[47,48,49,50,51], ENTIRELY fresh -- neither R_STAR nor the extended sweep were derived from any of these seeds, unlike 935 which mixed derivation seeds (42-44) with partly-fresh seeds (45-46) in one run; the in-run C2-out-of-sample split 935 used is therefore not carried forward (935's C3, beats-best-absolute-cap, is renamed this run's C2 -- two load-bearing criteria, not three; see DESIGN SIMPLIFICATION in the driver's module docstring). Two-mode scope (internal_replay/offline_consolidation were exactly 0 in all 35 of 935's cells) reported explicitly in the manifest. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (occupancy at r=2.45 and the extended sweep on seeds 47-51) recorded in no manifest -- seeds 47-51 have never run in this lineage -> not recoverable, run. | Step 2.5b re-derive brake: MECH-266/SD-032a counted 7 genuinely-braking prior autopsies (464b/c/d, 467b/c/d, 797; threshold 2). Named upstream substrate mode-governance-engagement LANDED (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md: external-task-salience-source-for.md 2026-06-13; regime-occupancy-reproducibility.md 2026-09-11) -- brake RELEASED per Step 2.5b item 1. V3-EXQ-935 itself is independent confirmation: its own confirmed autopsy recommends SD-032a weakens->supports because the register 'performed better here than anywhere else in this lineage' (graded, non-degenerate occupancy 0.124-0.925, 15-26 genuine switches/cell on 4/5 seeds). | Step 2.5c substrate-path overlap gate: mode-governance-engagement was the one open corrupting-severity substrate_queue.json entry overlapping this driver's imports (via regime_occupancy_gate.py); governance cycle gov-20260911-1612/GFLAG-0262 reassessed severity corrupting->cosmetic, ready:false->true (no open defect remains for Step 2.5c to protect other experiments from -- confirmed live in substrate_queue.json at authoring time, 2026-09-14). No other open corrupting entry overlaps this driver's imports (ree_core.agent, causal_grid_world, ree_core.utils.config, regime_occupancy_gate, z_goal_stream). | DV-symmetry (per arm, mandatory declaration, unchanged from 935): DV=fraction_in_external_task, a function of argmax(operating_mode). ARM_NORM and ARM_ABS are BOTH NOT invariant under the DV's symmetry group (constant-offset / monotone-transform of all mode logits) -- the affinity cap clips BEFORE per-mode weighting while external_task_bias is added unclamped afterwards, so clamping moves logit DIFFERENCES; empirically confirmed non-invariant in 934's banked data (seed 42: 0.5606->0.0317->0.0 across caps; seed 43: 1.0->0.4447). | Smoke (--dry-run, 1 seed, run twice due to inherent P2-stage stochasticity at tiny dry-run episode budgets): both structurally clean (no crash, no exception); run 1 (guard-passed) correctly routed PASS/normalised_cap_rule_admits_common_mixed_regime; run 2 (guard contact_rate=0, a different random draw) correctly routed FAIL/substrate_not_ready_requeue/contact_guard_unmet. Both runs show 'ep N/29' progress lines, a 'Seed 47 Condition ...' boundary line, and a 'verdict: PASS/FAIL' line. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings (after fixing a criteria-threshold advisory by adding measured/threshold to both load-bearing criteria, and adding a >=2-distinct-testable-seeds guard on the H-KNIFE qualifying-r computation, matching classify_regime_shape's own DEFAULT_MIN_SEEDS floor, so a run with too few testable seeds cannot spuriously claim a qualifying r). | red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 1 finding FIXED, 3 DISMISSED with source citations, 1 rated CLEAR by the reviewer. FIXED (F1): the reachable state C1-passes-but-C2-fails fell through to the H-IDIO else-branch with a route_reason that would have been factually false there ('no r clears the bar' when R_STAR itself had) -- reproducing 935's own defect #2 inside this run's new logic; fixed by adding a distinct rule_grades_but_not_better_than_absolute_cap route (SD-032a direction: weakens), verified by an isolated synthetic test of all 8 (C1,C2,knife) truth-table combinations routing to 4 distinct, correctly-differentiated labels. DISMISSED (F3): affinity_input_cap confirmed read live from self.config at salience_coordinator.py:455 inside tick() -- no arm-order confound beyond ordinary harness-inherited per-cell RNG noise, unchanged from the validated 934/935 harness. DISMISSED (F4): H-KNIFE's single-r bar being looser than the full >=2-adjacent 'graded' classification is a deliberate, already-documented design choice -- it only ever selects between two FAIL sub-routes (rule_right_r_wrong_requeue vs cap_recalibration_is_seed_idiosyncratic), never manufactures a false PASS. DISMISSED (F5): the G-margin/G-calib 0.05 floor concern (possible under-sensitivity vs uninformative-softmax semantics) is inherited unchanged from the validated 934/935 driver, and 934/935's actual measured baseline margins (0.3217-0.8139 across seeds 42-46) sit far above both the floor and any hypothetical uninformative baseline in practice. CLEAR (F2, per reviewer's own rating): manipulation_landed's 1e-6 variation threshold is inherited unchanged from 934/935 and is out of this lettered fix's scope (not one of the autopsy's seven required changes). Causal chain (manipulation/DV/criteria) unchanged by the F1 fix -- only routing/labeling logic changed -- so no re-spawn, per the one-pass rule. predecessor: V3-EXQ-935 (successor; NOT a supersede -- 935's diagnosis of its own four defects stands).
